def VTask.map : {α : Type u_1} -> {β : Type u_2} -> (M : Matroid α) -> (f : α → β) -> (hf : Set.InjOn f M.E) -> Matroid β :=
  fun {α} {β} M f hf => {
    /-
    The image of a matroid `M` under an injective function on its ground set is a matroid where:
    1. The ground set is the image of `M.E` under `f`.
    2. The independent sets are the images of the independent sets of `M` under `f`.
    -/
    E := f '' M.E
    /-
    The ground set of the new matroid is the image of the ground set of `M` under `f`.
    -/
    indep := fun s : Finset β => ∃ t : Finset α, t ⊆ M.E ∧ M.Indep t ∧ f '' t = s
    /-
    A subset `s` of the new ground set is independent if it is the image of an independent subset `t` of `M.E` under `f`.
    -/
    le : ∀ (s t : Finset β), s ⊆ t → s ∈ this.indep → t ∈ this.indep := by
      intro s t hst hs
      rcases hs with ⟨t', ht'_sub, ht'_indep, ht'_eq⟩
      have h : f '' t' ⊆ f '' t := by
        have h₁ : t' ⊆ t := by
          have h₂ : f '' t' = s := ht'_eq
          have h₃ : f '' t = t := by
            have h₄ : t ∈ this.indep := by assumption
            rcases h₄ with ⟨t'', ht''_sub, ht''_indep, ht''_eq⟩
            simp_all [Finset.ext_iff]
            <;> aesop
          have h₅ : s ⊆ t := by
            simp_all [Finset.ext_iff]
            <;> aesop
          simp_all [Finset.ext_iff]
          <;> aesop
        exact Finset.image_subset _ h₁
      have h₁ : t ∈ this.indep := by
        have h₂ : ∃ t'' : Finset α, t'' ⊆ M.E ∧ M.Indep t'' ∧ f '' t'' = t := by
          have h₃ : t ∈ this.indep := by assumption
          rcases h₃ with ⟨t'', ht''_sub, ht''_indep, ht''_eq⟩
          exact ⟨t'', ht''_sub, ht''_indep, ht''_eq⟩
        rcases h₂ with ⟨t'', ht''_sub, ht''_indep, ht''_eq⟩
        refine' ⟨t'', ht''_sub, ht''_indep, _⟩
        <;> simp_all [Finset.ext_iff]
        <;> aesop
      exact h₁
    /-
    The set of independent sets is closed under taking subsets.
    -/
    fin : ∀ (s : Finset β), s ∈ this.indep → s ⊆ f '' M.E := by
      intro s hs
      rcases hs with ⟨t, ht_sub, ht_indep, ht_eq⟩
      have h₁ : f '' t ⊆ f '' M.E := by
        apply Finset.image_subset_image
        <;> simp_all [Set.InjOn]
        <;> aesop
      simp_all [Finset.ext_iff]
      <;> aesop
    /-
    Every independent set is a subset of the ground set.
    -/
    af : ∀ (s : Finset β), s ⊆ f '' M.E → s ∈ this.indep → ∀ (x : β), x ∈ f '' M.E → x ∉ s → ∃ (t : Finset β), t ∈ this.indep ∧ s ⊆ t ∧ t.card = s.card + 1 := by
      intro s hs hsf x hx hxs
      have h₁ : s ∈ this.indep := hsf
      rcases h₁ with ⟨t, ht_sub, ht_indep, ht_eq⟩
      have h₂ : x ∈ f '' M.E := hx
      have h₃ : x ∉ s := hxs
      have h₄ : s ⊆ f '' M.E := hs
      -- Use the fact that M is a matroid to extend t to a larger independent set containing f⁻¹(x)
      have h₅ : ∃ (a : α), a ∈ M.E ∧ f a = x := by
        rcases h₂ with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      rcases h₅ with ⟨a, ha, ha'⟩
      -- Check if a is already in t
      by_cases h₆ : a ∈ t
      · -- If a is in t, then x is already in s, which contradicts h₃
        exfalso
        have h₇ : f a ∈ f '' t := by
          apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
          exact ⟨a, ht_sub h₆, rfl⟩
        have h₈ : f a = x := ha'
        have h₉ : x ∈ f '' t := by simpa [h₈] using h₇
        have h₁₀ : x ∈ s := by
          have h₁₁ : f '' t = s := ht_eq
          rw [h₁₁] at h₉
          exact h₉
        contradiction
      · -- If a is not in t, then we can add it to t to get a larger independent set
        have h₇ : M.Indep (t ∪ {a}) := by
          have h₈ : M.Indep t := ht_indep
          have h₉ : a ∉ t := h₆
          have h₁₀ : M.Indep (t ∪ {a}) := by
            apply M.indep_union_singleton_of_not_in_span
            · exact ht_indep
            · intro h₁₁
              have h₁₂ : a ∈ M.span t := by simpa using h₁₁
              have h₁₃ : a ∈ t := by
                have h₁₄ : M.span t = ↑(M.span t) := by simp
                have h₁₅ : a ∈ (M.span t : Set α) := by simpa using h₁₂
                have h₁₆ : a ∈ M.span t := by simpa using h₁₅
                have h₁₇ : a ∈ t := by
                  apply M.mem_of_span_eq_bot
                  <;> simp_all [M.span_eq_bot]
                  <;> aesop
                exact h₁₇
              contradiction
          exact h₁₀
        -- The image of t ∪ {a} under f is s ∪ {x}
        have h₈ : f '' (t ∪ {a}) = s ∪ {x} := by
          have h₉ : f '' (t ∪ {a}) = f '' t ∪ f '' ({a} : Finset α) := by
            rw [Finset.image_union]
            <;> simp_all [Finset.disjoint_left]
            <;> aesop
          have h₁₀ : f '' t = s := ht_eq
          have h₁₁ : f '' ({a} : Finset α) = {x} := by
            simp [ha']
            <;> aesop
          rw [h₉, h₁₀, h₁₁]
          <;> simp [Finset.ext_iff]
          <;> aesop
        -- s ∪ {x} is independent
        refine' ⟨s ∪ {x}, ⟨t ∪ {a}, _, h₇, _⟩, _, _, _⟩ <;> simp_all [Finset.card_union_eq]
        <;>
          (try aesop) <;>
          (try
            {
              have h₉ : a ∉ t := h₆
              simp_all [Finset.card_union_eq]
              <;> aesop
            }) <;>
          (try
            {
              simp_all [Finset.card_union_eq]
              <;> aesop
            })
    /-
    The set of independent sets satisfies the augmentation property.
    -/
    -- The set of independent sets is non-empty (it contains the empty set)
    empty : ∃ (s : Finset β), s ∈ this.indep := by
      refine' ⟨∅, _⟩
      -- The empty set is independent because it is the image of the empty set under f
      refine' ⟨∅, by simp, M.empty_indep, _⟩
      <;> simp
    }
